name: Tanabe (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tanabe city emblem in white: a five-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tanabe, a city in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Tanabe city emblem — a five-pointed star enclosing a ring with a stylised character
